issue_request: FHIR-13539 was a Published/Persuasive PA change request from STU3 asking Encounter.location to specify which level of the location hierarchy is being recorded. The resolution added Encounter.location.physicalType 0..1 CodeableConcept with an example binding to the location physical type value set to support direct bed, room, ward, or similar recording for messaging and query.
initial_application: No available git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-13539, likely because the source import/history post-dates the STU3 application. The imported Encounter source already contained Encounter.location.physicalType with the requested 0..1 CodeableConcept shape, the bed/ward/room messaging-or-query definition, and an example binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/location-physical-type.
additional_context: Encounter is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml is in the current build. FHIR-36815 later renamed Location.physicalType to Location.form, renamed the value set to location-form, added virtual location support, and explicitly renamed Encounter.location.physicalType to Encounter.location.form for consistency. source/fhir.ini also maps the old Encounter.location.physicalType path to Encounter.location.form. FHIR-57398 is a later Resolved - change required clarification for Location.form and Encounter.location.form, but it is not Applied or Published and was not decided in this default run.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Encounter.location.form element is the renamed continuation of the FHIR-13539 physicalType element: it is 0..1 CodeableConcept, retains the same definition about specifying bed/ward/room/etc. levels for messaging or query, and binds with example strength to the current location-form value set. Reintroducing physicalType or adding duplicate prose would conflict with FHIR-36815 without changing the seed issue semantics.
